description: §5.2 "Data-supplied CSS-url attributes — runtime guard (S473)": a data write of fill / stroke / filter / mask / clip-path / marker-start / cursor (on SVG AND HTML elements, any name case) is judged by the §25.7 bridge's value check — a url(…) to another document, a fallback paint after url(#id), and a non-plain value animating `fill` are REMOVED, initially and on a reactive re-write; a plain colour, a filter function list and exactly `url(#ident)` are written. Written in the parenthesized form both implementations compile. impl#1 built under the S479 carve-out 2 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S479-3B-rest-item-21, gap g-impl1-svg-css-url-attr-and-link-stylesheet-href-unguarded-s473); before it, impl#1 wrote every one of these values raw.
rationale: §5.2: "Every write from data of an attribute whose name, lowercased, is a CSS-url attribute, on ANY element (SVG, HTML or custom — matched by name, fail closed)"; "Also every write from data of an SVG animation value (`to` / `from` / `by` / `values` …) whose static `attributeName` names a CSS-url attribute"; "The value … SHALL be admitted only if the §25.7 bridge's value check (`cssValueOf`) admits it, or it is the one `url(#ident)` form" (a Filter Effects 1 filter function admitted for these attributes); "a fallback paint (`url(#grad) red`)" is refused; "The attribute SHALL be removed, not written".
